## 📦 New Email ➔ Create Google Task

**Purpose**: ## Required Setup:
Make sure the Gmail label "To-Do" exists. (You can create it manually in Gmail settings if it doesn't.)

Connect your Gmail and Google Tasks accounts via OAuth2 in n8n credentials.

Grant necessary access scopes to read emails and manage tasks.

**Services needed**: gmailTrigger, googleTasks, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
